name: phorbol-12-myristate-13-acetate-induced protein 1
pathways: positive regulation of DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator

function.text: PMAIP1 encodes phorbol-12-myristate-13-acetate-induced protein 1. It participates in positive regulation of DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator and apoptotic process.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.
